pred_texts: Instruct: Take two pieces of toast and put them in the toaster. Toast for about three minutes until they are golden brown.
Instruct: Now take a microwave-safe mug and crack two eggs into the mug.
Instruct: Now add a pinch of salt to the mixture.
Instruct: Now add two tablespoons of grated cheese into the mixture.
Instruct: Now stir the mixture until the egg is evenly blended.
Instruct: Now microwave the mixture for about 45 seconds, until it is set.
Instruct: Now remove the egg mixture and cut it into two pieces and add one half of it on each toast.
Instruct: Now you can add one tablespoon of grated cheese on top of each toast.
Instruct: Now microwave for around 15 seconds until the cheese is slightly melted.
